# AI prose-fatigue research ledger

This directory is an inspectable, issue-scoped research record for MARK-371. It is not a detector, a list of prohibited words, or a claim that a text is AI-authored. It supports later, bounded style guidance only when the relevant context, audience, and evidence class are made explicit.

`evidence-ledger.md` separates what a source measured from limited implementation inferences and open hypotheses. `source-register.json` records stable primary records, their limits, retrieval date, and review horizon. Neither file stores source corpora or private author samples.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-25. Next review: 2027-02-25.
